title: D-Wave Quantum Inc.
summary: D-Wave is the only commercially operational quantum computer company, running a quantum annealing approach rather than gate-based universal quantum computing.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

D-Wave is the only commercially operational quantum computer company, running a quantum annealing approach rather than gate-based universal quantum computing. The Advantage2 system (7,000+ qubits) is available via D-Wave's Leap cloud service and has been deployed for logistics optimisation, drug discovery, and financial modelling. Quantum annealing solves a narrower class of problems than universal QC but does so today, not in 2030+. Customers include Volkswagen, USSC, Mastercard, and NTT. Key risk: quantum annealing is a niche approach that may be displaced by gate-based universal QC before it achieves commercial scale. Speculative micro-cap: high volatility, sentiment-driven trading around quantum news.

Future Tech Roadmap

Quantum Supremacy (Narrow Task) Confirmed Ongoing
📈 D-Wave has demonstrated quantum advantage on specific optimisation problems. This is narrow-task supremacy, not general-purpose advantage.
Quantum Drug / Molecular Simulation Researching 2028
📈 D-Wave is targeting pharmaceutical discovery via quantum annealing: protein folding and molecular optimisation are candidate applications.
Fault-Tolerant QC (1000 Logical Qubits) Speculative 2030+
📈 D-Wave's annealing architecture differs fundamentally from gate-based fault-tolerant QC. D-Wave is a near-term beneficiary; long-term may be displaced by universal QC.
